goal: Reframe the program around one question: for arbitrary CNF input F, which regions are already covered by exact polynomial-time lanes, which are only parameterized/representation-conditional, and what residual remains without a polynomial universal closure theorem?

universal_target.statement: One deterministic exact algorithm A must decide SAT/UNSAT for every finite CNF F and satisfy one fixed polynomial total bound in the original encoding length.
universal_target.required_total_cost: T_recognize + T_transform + T_discover + T_solve + T_reconstruct + T_verify + certificate_bytes <= poly(|F|)
universal_target.allowed_architecture: Portfolio/multi-language/multi-carrier is allowed. Universality does not require one representation, only one uniform polynomial algorithm with exact transitions and complete coverage.
universal_target.final_missing_theorem_shape: FOR_ALL reachable nonterminal residuals, either a polynomial terminal lane applies, or a polynomially discoverable exact transition enters such a lane or decreases a globally polynomially bounded potential without superpolynomial representation growth.

classification_rule.P_LANE: The lane has a polynomial recognizer/admission condition and polynomial exact decision/reconstruction over the entire claimed class.
classification_rule.PARAM_LANE: Runtime is f(k)*poly(n). It counts as polynomial coverage only under an independently established input-wide bound making f(k)<=poly(n), e.g. single-exponential f and k=O(log n), or fixed constant k.
classification_rule.REPRESENTATION_PROOF_ACCELERATOR: Queries/extraction are polynomial once a compact representation/proof is supplied, but no polynomial compilation/proof-generation theorem exists for arbitrary CNF. This is not universal coverage.
classification_rule.EXACT_PREPROCESSOR: Polynomial exact simplification/reencoding that may expose another lane but has no universal closure guarantee by itself.
classification_rule.STRUCTURAL_ACCELERATOR: Computes/optimizes a structural object useful to later solving, but is not itself a complete SAT decision lane without an exact bridge.

direct_public_P_lanes.name: HORN_CNF
direct_public_P_lanes.recognition: syntactic linear scan: at most one positive literal per clause
direct_public_P_lanes.reference: Dowling-Gallier, Linear-time algorithms for testing the satisfiability of propositional Horn formulae, 1984, DOI 10.1016/0743-1066(84)90014-1

direct_public_P_lanes.name: DUAL_HORN_CNF
direct_public_P_lanes.recognition: syntactic linear scan: at most one negative literal per clause
direct_public_P_lanes.reference: Schaefer tractable Boolean CSP class; dual of Horn

direct_public_P_lanes.name: RENAMABLE_HORN
direct_public_P_lanes.recognition: known linear-time recognition of the renamable-Horn class
direct_public_P_lanes.reference: classical renamable-Horn literature; later summaries explicitly state linear recognition

direct_public_P_lanes.name: Q_HORN
direct_public_P_lanes.solve: linear-time SAT once q-Horn representation/valuation is obtained

direct_public_P_lanes.janus_note: R39 only rejected one frozen fixpoint and did not implement the general public recognizer. Universal portfolio should import the real recognizer rather than re-test q-Horn locally.

direct_public_P_lanes.reference: Ordyniak-Paulusma-Szeider, Satisfiability of acyclic and almost acyclic CNF formulas, TCS 481 (2013), DOI 10.1016/j.tcs.2012.12.039

parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.name: STRONG_BACKDOOR_TO_HORN

parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.solve_after_detection: enumerate at most 2^k assignments, solve Horn residuals
parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.polynomial_coverage_condition: k=O(log N) with the known single-exponential detector/solver
parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.reference: Nishimura-Ragde-Szeider, Detecting Backdoor Sets with Respect to Horn and Binary Clauses, SAT 2004

parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.name: BACKDOOR_DEPTH_TO_HORN_OR_KROM
parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.known_result: FPT approximation/detection machinery and linear-time SAT for bounded depth
parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.polynomial_coverage_condition: fixed/bounded depth as covered by the theorem; do not infer logarithmic-depth polynomiality without an explicit dependence f(k)
parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.reference: Dreier-Ordyniak-Szeider, SAT backdoors: Depth beats size, JCSS 142 (2024), DOI 10.1016/j.jcss.2024.103520

parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.name: INCIDENCE_TREEWIDTH

parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.polynomial_coverage_condition: k=O(log N) for single-exponential DP plus polynomial/FPT decomposition discovery, or fixed k
references: Samer-Szeider, A Fixed-Parameter Algorithm for #SAT with Parameter Incidence Treewidth, arXiv:cs/0610174

parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.name: BA25_VARIABLE_LOCALIZED_FACTOR_GRAPH
parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.parameter: tau = supplied verified tree-decomposition width of G_star

parameterized_lanes_that_become_polynomi.name: BA24_HYBRID_DBO_FOREIGN_CNF

janus_structural_or_representation_lanes.potential_use: If a source-bound residual-to-subspace bridge is proved and the resulting k=O(log N), A3 can become a polynomial structural lane.

historical_janus_negative_coverage_evide.fact: A reachable nonsemantic stalled fixpoint refuted universal coverage of the then-fixed controller.
Explicit reachable counterexample refuted the one-swap macro grammar.
Explicit reachable counterexample refuted the single-DP plus existing-stack closure grammar.
Adversarial search found a reachable non-affine residual with no RUP or strict-descending SA-BVE door under the frozen W policy.
Minimal stalled core had only lexicographically non-descending exact-DP doors; controlled growth was necessary on that example.

Pure variable-count descent via Davis-Putnam is not a universal polynomial argument because classical fill-in can be exponential; the attempted universal controlled-DP audit ended UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT and produced no scientific PASS.

current_residual_frontier_v1.name: GENERAL_MIXED_HIGH_WIDTH_NO_SMALL_BACKDOOR_RESIDUAL
definition_relative_to_current_portfolio: arbitrary CNF after only semantics-preserving polynomial preprocessing
not directly admitted by Horn, dual-Horn, Krom/2CNF, renamable-Horn, q-Horn, beta-acyclic, or another imported direct P-lane
no polynomially discovered/certified logarithmic-size strong backdoor to an imported P-lane
no polynomially discovered/certified O(log N) incidence/factor-graph width bound giving a 2^O(k)*poly(N) solve
not already terminal under exact affine/source-specific or component/interface lanes
may require a locally non-descending exact elimination step
no theorem guarantees that repeated controlled growth stays inside one polynomial root envelope before a tractable lane opens
current_residual_frontier_v1.important_property: This residual is relative to the current portfolio, not a canonical complexity class and not evidence of hardness.
current_residual_frontier_v1.known_obstruction_shape: Davis-Putnam/bucket fill-in and width growth can be exponential in general; therefore 'eliminate one variable per step' is insufficient.
current_residual_frontier_v1.missing_universal_statement: For every residual in this class, prove a polynomially discoverable exact route that either enters a P-lane/PARAM-lane with polynomial parameter bound or yields certified progress under a globally polynomial representation/work budget.

highest_priority_imports_before_new_mech.why: Public linear algorithm exists; JANUS R39 only performed a local finite rejection.
Direct polynomial CNF class not represented as a first-class JANUS terminal lane.
Cheap direct expansion of exact terminal coverage.
Transforms logarithmically close instances into a provably polynomial lane and provides a principled bridge from hard residuals to known P classes.
BA25 already verifies a closely related FPT solver; combining it with a public decomposition algorithm turns certified low-width residuals into an actual discoverable lane.

next_theory_target_after_imports.name: UNIVERSAL_RESIDUAL_FUNNEL_THEOREM
next_theory_target_after_imports.not_the_old_form: Do not require a strict-descending pivot in the original CLV order at every residual.
next_theory_target_after_imports.candidate_form: For every residual not recognized by an imported P-lane, either discover a polynomially bounded structural parameter/backdoor placing it in a PARAM-lane, or perform an exact controlled-growth macro whose cumulative charged representation/work stays polynomial and that strictly decreases a well-founded global funnel measure toward one of the admitted lanes.
next_theory_target_after_imports.hard_part: Prove FOR_ALL coverage plus a global polynomial bound; finite controllers/benchmarks are falsifiers only.

anti_self_deception_rules: FPT != P unless the parameter bound is tied to input length strongly enough to make f(k) polynomial.
Compact representation exists != polynomial compiler exists.
Short proof/witness exists != polynomial discovery exists.
Variable count decreases != representation/work stays polynomial.
Residual function count exponential != computation necessarily requires exponential states.
A3 pathwidth theorem != SAT lane without a source-bound exact SAT bridge.
Given decomposition != polynomial decomposition discovery unless separately supplied.
